output.summary: CSD's 95% green dashboard is not reliable. It is self-reported with no objective criteria, and green share rose from 64% to over 90% after the Nov 2025 memo and the percent-green bonus. Audit found 4 of 6 sampled green projects behind, and customer escalations preceded status changes. CSD met 36% of customer commitments against 83-87% elsewhere. Platform delays are mostly driven by CSD's late, incomplete requests, with a modest Platform capacity shortfall as a secondary factor. Evidence does not show the SVP knowingly directed false status. Survey participation fell for CSD specifically, so survey fatigue is unlikely. Fix the measurement and incentives first. Do not transfer engineers, remove the SVP or deanonymize comments.
